label: Documents
description: How invoices and credit notes are created. A finalized document gets its number, its payment booking and its PDF at once, and cannot be changed or deleted afterwards. A draft has no number yet: review it in sevdesk, then finalize it there or in Swell. Start with drafts. The layout, the letterhead and the number ranges come from your sevdesk account. A taxed sale to another EU country is booked by the tax rate charged: German rates as German revenue, any other rate under the One-Stop-Shop. Choose Always under the One-Stop-Shop if you are registered for it.

fields.label: Create documents as
fields.description: A finalized document gets its number, its payment is booked and its PDF is stored at once. It cannot be changed or deleted afterwards, only corrected. A draft has no number yet: review it in sevdesk, where it can still be edited or deleted, and finalize it there or in Swell. Start with drafts.

options.label: German for DE, AT, CH and LI, English elsewhere

fields.label: Sales to other EU countries
fields.description: Which sevdesk tax rule a taxed sale to another EU country gets. By the rate charged: German rates are booked as taxable revenue in Germany, any other rate under the One-Stop-Shop rules. Choose One-Stop-Shop if you are registered for it, so that a destination country whose rate equals a German one is booked correctly too.

fields.label: Create credit notes for refunds
fields.description: Each refund of an order that has a sevdesk invoice becomes a credit note for that invoice.

fields.label: E-mail finalized documents to customers, with a link to the PDF
fields.description: Sends each finalized invoice and credit note to the customer, with a link to the PDF. The e-mail can be edited under Settings → Notifications. Drafts are not sent.
